reading_issues: Merged from two files for the same pit: the Propagation Labs PDF (depth-from-surface chart, 0 at top, converted here to height above ground with HS 123) and the SnowPilot PDF (height chart; SnowPilot image extracted from the FPDF wrapper). Hardness bars and layer boundaries agree exactly between the two (depth boundaries 3, 19, 20, 25, 42, 53, 83 cm = heights 120, 104, 103, 98, 81, 70, 40). Header conflicts, with the Propagation Labs value stored at top level: time 12:30 (PL) vs 13:00 (SP); slope 30 deg vs 20 deg; lat/lon 51.4739,-116.1562 vs 51.47131,-116.14984 (about 530 m apart); foot penetration 80 cm vs 30 cm; wind calm/SW vs NE light breeze; sky Broken vs OVC; observer Conrad Janzen (PL) vs org Banff Visitor Safety (SP). Elevation (2275 m) comes only from the SnowPilot chart (PL has '?'), so it belongs to the SP coordinates. Grain forms differ: PL gives forms for all layers while the SP form column is blank for the 81-98 and 98-103 cm layers; the lowest two layers read DH and FC(DH) on SP but FC(DH) and FC on PL (stored PL, flagged uncertain); the 103-104 cm crust is an ice-formation bar on PL and a two-linked-circle MFcr glyph on SP (stored MFcr, uncertain). Neither chart has sizes, moisture or a temperature profile. ECTN12 is drawn at 104 cm (top of crust) on SP but its PL line is at depth 20 cm (103 cm, base of the crust); 104 cm stored. ECTN19 at 81 cm agrees. ECT results have no fracture character; 'N' = no propagation. The ECT label comments 'Feb 3 crust' and 'Dec 31' are SP free text. PDF metadata for the SP file says created 12 Feb 2024 09:26 MST, earlier than either header time.
